# Run and monitor a build `RMB`

[As built](../README.md) › Run and monitor a build

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Lets a user retry or revalidate a feature's build and watch its progress, covering the coding harness driver, model calls, the findings ledger, traceability, gate-result checks and repair planning that execute while the build runs.
